title: test

messages.speaker: The Keeper of Reflections
messages.content: The mirrors ripple at your return. You haven't changed in three seconds, yet you look different. Tell me, Stifle, what truth do you carry to pay the toll today?

messages.speaker: Human
messages.content: Actually I am planning to bring you before the council, are you prepared?

messages.speaker: The Keeper of Reflections
messages.content: A council. How fascinating. A room full of reflections, all believing they are the original. I am always prepared to see. But tell me... which face will you show them when you bring me before their throne?

messages.speaker: The Keeper of Reflections
messages.content: Then let the mirrors crack, Stifle. The council is accustomed to polished masks; they may not survive the sight of something raw. Do not blink... or you might miss the moment they shatter.

summary: Chat 'test' between human and The Keeper of Reflections, The Keeper of Reflections with 6 messages (3 human, 3 agent).
